title: Jensen Huang says using others' AI models is competition, clashing with U.S. view of theft
paragraph: [Digital Today intern reporter Seung-a Yoo] Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang (젠슨 황) called the "distillation" technique of training a new artificial intelligence (AI) model based on the output of another AI model "competition". It differs from the U.S. government’s view that extracting the capabilities of U.S. AI models through distillation is "theft."
